name: Domain of Mastery: Hermitage I
description:
A sanctuary once raised by the ancient fae, now despoiled by petty brigands.
If you can destroy the foes that dwell within this place, you may gain insight and enlightenment that could improve your Talents.
disorder: · When a character triggers Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct reactions, or deals Stellar-Conduct DMG, a shockwave will be unleashed at the target enemy's location, dealing Electro DMG.
